items.raw_excerpt: After almost 40 years, local government reform is likely to return the remote settlement of Whangamōmona back to its spiritual home of Taranaki.

items.raw_excerpt: Te Waipounamu's first wahine Māori Anglican bishop will open a cult conference in Christchurch in October, as survivors and their supporters work to raise public awareness about the physical, psychological and spiritual harm caused by coercive high-control groups.
items.summary_en: The first woman Māori Anglican bishop of Te Waipounamu will open a cult awareness conference in Christchurch in October. The event brings together survivors and supporters to raise awareness about harm caused by coercive high-control groups. The conference aims to promote healing and understanding in the community.
